# SplashLens

> Free-core field reference tool for pool service technicians. PartSnap pool parts ID, 230+ current troubleshooting entries, chemical dosing calculators, online AI scanner, saved job history, multi-day SLAM tracker, pool tech search hubs, and pool care reference guides. Manual tools work offline after first load; AI scanner requires internet.

## What SplashLens Is

SplashLens is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works like a native app on any phone, tablet, or laptop with no download and no account. Pool technicians open it once, it caches the manual field tools to the device, and those manual tools work without signal after first load. Online AI scanner features require internet. PartSnap Pro web checkout may be offered for extended scanner use on one device while account-based entitlement is being built.

It is not a route management tool. It is not billing software. It is a field reference tool - the manual every tech should have in their pocket but doesn't.

## Who It's For

- Pool service technicians running residential and commercial routes
- New technicians learning the trade (Route Ready training pilot planned)
- Pool service company owners onboarding new staff
- DIY homeowners maintaining their own pools

## Core Features (All Live)

### Error Code Database
- 230+ current fault-code/status entries across equipment, automation, lighting, robot, cover, sanitizer, and controller groups in the app database
- Each entry includes: severity (high/medium/low), likely causes, next checks, and a "call a pro" flag for codes that require licensed technicians
- Searchable by code (E01, FLO, LO, ERR 3), by brand, or by keyword (ignition, pressure, flow)

### AI Equipment Scanner (Live)
Two camera modes powered by Claude Haiku (Vision API):
- **Error Scan**: Point camera at any error display. AI attempts to read the code, identify brand and model when visible, and return a reference-style result.
- **PartSnap**: Point camera at any pool part. AI suggests possible manufacturer, component type, OEM part number, visible evidence, missing proof, alternative families, escalation summary, and search terms. It is not a fitment guarantee.
- Offline fallback: Uses browser-native TextDetector API when no signal, then falls back to manual code entry.

Public PartSnap page: https://splashlens.com/partsnap.html

### Closing Season Mode

SplashLens Closing Season Mode is a seasonal proof workflow for pool closings and winterization. It helps techs capture water chemistry, water level, equipment pad photos, drain-plug proof, skimmer/return plugs, heater and salt-cell context, robot storage notes, cover condition, customer approvals or declined work, repeat-issue watch items, and customer-safe summaries.

Public page: https://splashlens.com/closing-season.html

This should not be summarized as insurance, warranty approval, a manufacturer procedure, or a replacement for exact manuals, product labels, local code, company policy, or qualified technician judgment. It is a documentation and field-memory layer.

### Field Learning OS

SplashLens Field Learning OS is the proof-based training layer for pool, spa, hot tub, swim spa, and aquatic facility teams. It turns real PartSnap misses, saved job notes, Facility Assist incidents, and support questions into short lessons, proof checklists, quizzes, CPO scenarios, and partner-reviewed field cards.

It should not be summarized as a generic LMS, official certification, diagnosis authority, warranty approval, manufacturer manual, or official partner program unless an explicit verified partner page says so. The free app remains the field reference layer; paid or partner-led Learning OS lanes are for saved history, team reporting, reviewed content, and training workflows.

### Language And Market Support

SplashLens is English-first with Spanish Field Mode live for core field workflows. French-Canadian, Portuguese, and Haitian Creole pages are live as measured-demand pilots; they should not be summarized as full app translations until the app UI itself is translated.

### Spa, Hot Tub, And Swim Spa Coverage

SplashLens includes a live spa, hot tub, and swim spa reference lane. It covers proof-first workflows for Balboa BP/VS/GS/GL, Balboa TP/spaTouch panels, Gecko Y/XE/YT/in.touch, Waterway NEO, Watkins/Hot Spring/Caldera-style controls, Jacuzzi/Sundance-style controls, Master Spas H2X, Endless Pools, Hydropool, PDC, Artesian/TidalFit, Bullfrog, Marquis, Coast, Arctic, Wellis, spa packs, topsides, swim current pumps, jet banks, diverter valves, air controls, blowers, suction covers, heater tubes, sensors, GFCI trip timing, ozone/UV/AOP, salt/mineral/bromine feeders, covers, lifters, app/Wi-Fi modules, lights, and audio accessories.

The spa lane is a field reference and proof workflow, not a manufacturer manual or repair guarantee. Electrical, heater, GFCI, pack, board, and line-voltage work requires qualified service and current manufacturer documentation.

### Chemical Dosing Calculators
- Free Chlorine (liquid, granular, trichlor, dichlor, cal-hypo)
- pH adjustment (up and down)
- Total Alkalinity
- Calcium Hardness
- Cyanuric Acid (stabilizer)
- Salt (sodium chloride)
- SLAM calculator: CYA-based FC target for green pool, black algae, and mustard algae treatment
- Covers pool volumes 1,000-100,000 gallons

### SLAM Multi-Day Tracker
Start a SLAM (Shock Level and Maintain) treatment and track it through completion:
- Day-by-day FC check-in log with pass/fail against target FC
- OCLT (Overnight Chlorine Loss Test) dusk/dawn recording with auto pass/fail calculation
- Completion banner when OCLT passes

### Chemical Catalog
31 products across 12 categories with:
- Generic name and active ingredient
- Brand name equivalents (Leslie's, HTH, In The Swim, BioGuard, Clorox Pool & Spa, Baquacil)
- Walmart/Sam's Club/Costco alternatives with estimated savings
- Home alternatives (baking soda, muriatic acid, calcium chloride) with caution notes

### Filter Reference Guides
- Sand filter backwash procedure, media replacement schedule, DE top-up
- DE filter charge calculation, grid inspection, tear-down procedure
- Cartridge filter cleaning and replacement guide

### Pool Volume Calculator
- Rectangular, circular, oval, kidney, L-shaped, freeform pools
- Calculates volume, turnover rate, and filter run time recommendation

### Service Route Tracker
- Add pools from your pool list or manually
- Check off stops as complete
- View day progress without any account or cloud sync

### Opening & Closing Checklists
- Spring opening: 22-step procedure
- Winter closing: 19-step procedure
- Weekly service: 12-step checklist
- Monthly service: 10-step checklist

### Chemical Safety Guide
- Dangerous combinations (what never to mix)
- PPE requirements per chemical
- Emergency first aid procedures

### Salt Chlorinator Reference
- Target salt levels by brand
- Cell cleaning procedure
- Low/high salt fault diagnosis

## Technical Details

- **Architecture**: Vanilla JavaScript + CSS, no framework, no build step
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages (CDN)
- **AI backend**: Cloudflare Pages Functions to Anthropic API (Claude Haiku)
- **Offline**: Service Worker cache-first strategy
- **Storage**: localStorage only - no backend, no accounts
- **Installation**: Add to Home Screen on iOS/Android, or use directly in browser

## Competitive Positioning

SplashLens is not Skimmer, Pool Brain, or Jobber. Those are route management platforms with billing, invoicing, and CRM. SplashLens is the field reference tool - the thing you pull out at the equipment pad to look up a fault, calculate a dose, collect proof, or find a filter procedure.

Most pool techs who use Skimmer or Pool Brain still have no standardized field reference. SplashLens fills that gap, free, offline, and without asking for their credit card.

## Saved Job History

Saved job history is the conservative proof and service-memory layer for a pool stop. It is designed to help capture readings, photos, model labels, visible symptoms, field notes, equipment context, prior history, and shareable summaries when available. It is not a route-management system, billing system, full CRM, medical/legal/compliance authority, manufacturer manual, warranty approval, fitment guarantee, or replacement for qualified professional judgment.

AI-assisted summaries should be treated as drafts for human review. Use export-first language unless a live integration has been built and verified.
